WAVE 12 M-3 -- THE FALSIFIER.  These are WAVE 11's TWO CONDITIONS, reproduced on
the changed tree.  `hdl/build_id.v` is written BY HAND in each arm because
nothing generates it any more; the point of the wave is that it is now INERT.
The two sha256s are the ones WAVE 11 recorded, and the 260909 one is the value a
COMMITTED RECEIPT holds (sw/testdata/g6dist/wave7-chainflat-noexc-control-n5/
seed1_quartus_gate.json, its `build_id` field) -- not a value computed from recall.
Pipeline: sw/run_biu_roundtrip.py --clean-db --control-seeds 1 --retention-seeds ''
(WAVE 10's driver, WAVE 11's invocation), no-exception SDC, identical in both arms.
